_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): multi-tenancy — tenants + memberships + request-scoped tenant resolution and a scoped() query helper. Row-level scoping (tenant_id column), pairs with feature-auth.
name: feature-tenancy
description: Multi-tenant foundation: Tenant model + memberships, X-Tenant-Slug resolution dependency, require_role guard, and scoped(query, tenant_id) helper for row-level isolation.

variables.name: app_name
variables.description: Python package name, e.g. 'app' or 'demo_api' (drives all nested imports)

notes: After applying: 1) import models.tenant in main.py so tables are created, 2) add tenant_id Integer FK column to every business model you want isolated, then wrap queries with tenancy.scoped(stmt, tenant.id), 3) resolve the active tenant per request via Depends(get_current_tenant) (X-Tenant-Slug header or the user's single membership), 4) owner-only routes use Depends(require_role('admin')). Requires feature-auth for get_current_user/users table.
